title: Sustained downstream interruption (section A–B), isolation confirmed
description: The simulated conductor between Node A and Node B parts. Node A keeps supply; B and C lose it. The virtual controller's local protection trips the source-side relay; the relay's feedback contact reports OPEN.
what_to_look_for: The controller trips before the server confirms the loss, so the feeder goes NORMAL → ISOLATION COMMANDED → ISOLATED (feedback confirmed).
Topology highlights section S-AB as the ESTIMATED section, with the evidence lines and the wording 'interruption suspected', never 'conductor broken'.
After isolation all nodes read ~0 V (de-energised on purpose); the location stays held from before isolation.
One INTERRUPTION_SUSPECTED event with isolation requested and confirmed.
